title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten verified free activities at Illinois State University and around Normal, including galleries, gardens, public programs, and student events.

cards.entity_name: University Galleries of Illinois State University
cards.title: Browse University Galleries
cards.subtitle: Contemporary art at Uptown Station
cards.notes: Meet at Uptown Station, explore the current exhibitions together, and leave time to compare favorite works before the gallery closes.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission contemporary-art outing in Uptown Normal.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries states that all exhibitions and events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit the Galleries | University Galleries | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Open to the public. The official page lists summer hours and advises that additional open hours resume August 9.

cards.title: Walk the Horticulture Center
cards.subtitle: Gardens and native spaces north of campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a garden walk, look through the native spaces, and plan the visit between dawn and dusk when public access is listed.
cards.short_summary: A free garden-and-nature break on university grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s Horticulture Center brochure says the center is open to the public from dawn to dusk most days and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Friends of the Illinois State University Horticulture Center Program
cards.access_notes: Public access is listed from dawn to dusk most days of the year. Donations are accepted but are not required for admission.

cards.title: Explore Local History Galleries
cards.subtitle: Seven exhibit galleries in downtown Bloomington
cards.notes: Take student identification, enter from Washington Street, and compare finds across the museum’s seven local-history galleries.
cards.short_summary: A student-free museum visit centered on McLean County history.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s current admission page lists students and children as free and also offers free admission to everyone every Tuesday.
cards.source_title: Visit | McLean County Museum of History
cards.access_notes: Students receive free admission; bring student identification. All visitors are admitted free on Tuesdays and on Saturday mornings during the May–October Farmers’ Market.

cards.title: Connect Outside in Uptown
cards.subtitle: Free public Wi-Fi around Uptown Normal
cards.notes: Meet in Uptown, connect to Normal Wi-Fi, and use the outdoor network for a shared study session or low-key online game break.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor, no-purchase digital hang near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Normal provides a free outdoor wireless network around Uptown Normal and free public networks at several municipal facilities.
cards.source_title: Access the Town's Free Public Wi-Fi Networks | Normal, IL
cards.access_notes: The network is public and free. Outdoor coverage and speed may vary with weather and crowding; Normal Wi-Fi is also available inside Uptown Station.

cards.entity_name: All-Ages Animation Workshop at University Galleries
cards.title: Make a Short Animation
cards.subtitle: A free hands-on workshop on August 15
cards.notes: Register before arriving, tour Selina Trepp’s exhibition, then create an animation with provided materials and stay for the screening.
cards.short_summary: A guided gallery visit followed by collaborative animation-making.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s August 2026 calendar lists the August 15 All-Ages Animation Workshop as free and says all materials are provided.
cards.source_title: Events for August 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 15, 2026, 12:30–3:30 p.m. at University Galleries. Registration is required; materials are provided.

cards.title: Join Conversations Café
cards.subtitle: Free campus conversation sessions in fall 2026
cards.notes: Choose a listed Friday session, arrive ready to meet new people, and use the hour for informal conversation in a campus setting.
cards.short_summary: A recurring free hour built around face-to-face conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s official fall 2026 calendars list Conversations Café sessions on September 4 and multiple October Fridays as free.
cards.source_title: Events for September 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: The September 4 session is listed from noon–1 p.m. and free. Consult the event listing for the current venue and participation details.

cards.title: Take a Therapy-Dog Break
cards.subtitle: A free Milner Library wellness event
cards.notes: Stop by with friends between classes, spend a few minutes with the visiting dogs, and follow staff guidance for calm animal interaction.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled campus decompression session with therapy dogs.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s September 2026 calendar lists PAWSitively Stress Free on September 9 from 1–3 p.m. as free.
cards.source_title: Events for September 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 9, 2026, 1–3 p.m. through Health Promotion and Wellness and Milner Library; listed as free.

cards.entity_name: Redbirds Remember: Saturday of Service for 9/11 Day
cards.title: Volunteer on Saturday of Service
cards.subtitle: A free community-service outing for Redbirds
cards.notes: Register with friends, select a service placement, and arrive prepared to support hunger relief, environmental, or first-responder projects.
cards.short_summary: A structured half-day of community service with local partners.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s September 2026 calendar lists Redbirds Remember on September 12 from 8:45 a.m.–1 p.m. as free.
cards.source_title: Events for September 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 12, 2026, 8:45 a.m.–1 p.m. The official listing marks it free; check the event entry for registration instructions.

cards.title: Swim and Climb Together
cards.subtitle: Free scheduled sessions at the Student Fitness Center
cards.notes: Pick a listed weekend session, bring the required recreation gear, and confirm participant eligibility before heading to the fitness center.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented pool and climbing-wall session on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s September 2026 calendar lists Family Swim and Climb sessions at the Student Fitness Center as free.
cards.source_title: Events for September 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Free sessions are listed for September 12 and 27, 2026. Confirm family eligibility, waivers, equipment rules, and the selected session time before attending.

cards.title: See a Free WGLT Film
cards.subtitle: A community screening about the importance of a free press
cards.notes: Save the September evening, meet before the screening, and check the listing again once WGLT announces the film title and venue details.
cards.short_summary: A free community movie night presented by Illinois State’s public-radio station.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State’s official calendar lists a free WGLT Film Series screening for September 29, 2026, from 6–9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Events for September 2026 | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 29, 2026, 6–9 p.m. and listed as free. The film title was still to be announced when fetched.
